html:
A union of the Fante states of the Gold Coast, formed at Mankessim in 1868 to defend against Asante and to govern themselves, which in 1871 wrote a written constitution.

The constitution, drafted by educated Fante, set up a king-president, an assembly, taxes, roads and schools. The British saw it as a threat, arrested its leaders, and the confederacy faded by 1873. A year later Britain declared the Gold Coast colony. Ghanaian nationalists later held it up as proof that Africans had tried to build a modern state before colonial rule. See also the Anglo-Ashanti wars.
